title: Coral reef organizations
wikitext:
Organizations which currently undertake [[coral reef]] and [[atoll]] restoration projects using simple methods of [[plant propagation]]:
* [https://web.archive.org/web/20080516071952/http://www.coralcay.org/expeditions/marine/fj1/ Coral Cay]
* [[Counterpart International]]<ref>[https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/b009jsjv 'The Coral Gardener'-documentary about Counterpart scientist Austin Bowden-Kerby]. Bbc.co.uk. Retrieved on 2011-11-01.</ref>
* [http://www.coralrestoration.org Coral Restoration Foundation (CRF) : Adopt a Coral]
* [https://ccrrp.mx Cozumel Coral Reef Restoration Program (CCRRP)] : Based on Cozumel, Mexico. They restore the local reefs and have a volunteer program.
* [https://oceangardener.org Ocean Gardener] : Indonesian NGO that conserves and restores coral reefs in Indonesia. Has tours, courses and volunteer programs and the proceeds go toward their coral restoration programs and helping local communities pivot to a regenerative economy. 
* U.S. Coral Reef Task Force (CRTF)
* [https://hcas.nova.edu/research/ncri.html National Coral Reef Institute (NCRI)]
* US Department of Commerce's National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA): [[Coral Reef Conservation Program]] (CRCP)
* National Center for Coral Reef Research (NCORE)
* [[Reef Ball]]
* Southeast Florida Coral Reef Initiative (SEFCRI)
*[https://www.reefrenewalbonaire.org Reef Renewal Foundation Bonaire (RRFB)]
*[https://www.reefrenewalcuracao.org/ Reef Renewal Foundation Curaçao (RRFC)]
* [https://web.archive.org/web/20080820193233/http://www.fspi.org.fj/programs.htm Foundation of the peoples of the South Pacific]
* [[WorldFishCenter]]: promotes sustainable [[mariculture]] techniques to grow reef [[organisms]] as [[tridacnidae]]
